activation_dependencies: Arm B terminal evidence and memory failure are frozen
the exclusive full-1G lease is released
source-labelled allocation attribution binds sufficient peak RSS to eligible fxcmv1 allocations
q0 malloc-trim/PPMd correction misses the engineering target or attribution proves it cannot supply the required margin
the exact donor source and integration patch are content-addressed
synthetic allocator, alignment, pageout, cleanup, and failure controls pass before codec execution

implementation.shared_allocator_module: gamma-filebacked-fxcm.h included directly by both codec and negative-control harness
implementation.layering: Apply the frozen q0 malloc-trim/PPMd correction first, then apply the q1 FXCM patch to that exact patched tree.
implementation.storage: one preallocated MAP_SHARED regular scratch file per eligible allocation
implementation.pageout: source-ordered MADV_PAGEOUT after predictor initialization and every 1,048,576 modeled bytes
implementation.cleanup: reverse-order munmap and inode-verified unlinkat, including process-terminal cleanup

semantic_invariants: new files provide calloc-equivalent zero bytes
mapping base, filename, inode, residency, faults, and pageout results never enter predictor state
ordinary CMIX prediction and update call sites remain unchanged
pageout changes residency only and never discards model-visible bytes
integer probability stream, coder state, compressed payload, decoded stream, raw inverse, and persistent state hashes equal the exact parent
parent and child self-extracting archives are expected to differ only through their separately counted program/package material
two independent q1 builds and runs produce byte-identical complete q1 archives
failure_policy: Any scratch-directory, open, reserve, mmap, registry, alignment, pageout, unmap, inode, or cleanup failure is an infrastructure failure. Eligible allocations never fall back to anonymous memory.
promotion_ladder: opening and distant 10MB exact identity with measured memory reduction
full 1GB A/B only after the engineering target projects feasible
reclassification_rule: Any integer probability, coder, payload, archive, or persistent-state difference creates a new compression candidate and restarts the archive ladder.
